text: Featured advantages This major is a discipline set up by Chutian scholars, a first-class professional construction point in Hubei Province, and a member of the International Elite Business School Association. It has a provincial-level internship training base and virtual simulation laboratory in Hubei universities, and has established cooperative relations with more than 20 well-known domestic enterprises such as Vanke Group and China Business Parity. The teaching staff is strong, 90% of the teachers come from the industry, pay attention to project-based teaching, adopt the "business-learning integration" characteristic talent training model, and cultivate a group of private entrepreneurs such as Lu Weijian, general manager of Asia Minor, and the student employment rate reaches more than 95%.Cultivation goals This major cultivates to meet the needs of economic and social development, develop morally, intellectually, physically, aesthetically and laboriously, and systematically master the basic theories, basic knowledge and basic skills of business administration; Familiar with the characteristics of modern enterprise management; Have the ability to innovate and start-up, rational decision-making and scientific leadership; High-quality application-oriented professionals who can engage in strategic decision-making, operation management, corporate governance, project investment and financing in enterprises, institutions and administrative departments.Core courses Management, Strategic Management, Organizational Behavior, Entrepreneurial Management, Operations Management, Corporate Governance, Human Resource Management, Financial Management, MIS, Marketing, Business Model Design, Market Research and Forecasting, Brand Building and Management, Entrepreneurial Theory and Practice.
